terminals.name: mock-sentinel
terminals.description: Fake Flipkart Sentinel export service on http://127.0.0.1:8081 (reads sentinel_mock).
terminals.command: cd /workspace && set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONPATH=/workspace && exec ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn mock.sentinel_api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081

terminals.name: collector-api
terminals.command: cd /workspace && set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONPATH=/workspace && exec ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn collector.api:api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

terminals.name: sentinel-worker
terminals.description: Procrastinate worker for the `sentinel` queue (-c 1). NOTE: the fetch->GCS->BigQuery leg needs Google Cloud credentials; without them a claimed page fails at the GCS write.
terminals.command: cd /workspace && set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONPATH=/workspace && export PROCRASTINATE_APP=collector.app.app && exec ./.venv/bin/python -m procrastinate worker -q sentinel -c 1 --delete-jobs never
